errors.text_span: Височината на сините стълбове варира между около 31000 и около 64000 хектара
errors.evidence: The description states that the height of the blue bars ranges from approximately 31,000 to 64,000 hectares. However, the chart clearly shows that all blue bars are consistently valued at or slightly above 60,000 hectares. The stated range is completely wrong.

errors.text_span: височината на оранжевите стълбове варира между около 26000 и около 44000 хектара
errors.evidence: The description states that the height of the orange bars ranges up to approximately 44,000 hectares. In the chart, the highest orange bar (in 2015) is at approximately 36,000 hectares, which is significantly lower than the stated maximum of 44,000.
